items.summary: Prevent the save-status badge (e.g., “Saving…”, “Saved”) displayed to the right of the project name in the header from causing any horizontal layout shift/jitter when it appears/disappears, while keeping it in the same position (right side of the project name) on desktop and in the mobile menu project header.

Redesign the Vault publishing instructions so they do not take up extra vertical space: remove the always-visible instructional text block under the Lock/Unlock/Upload buttons and replace it with hover tooltips on the Lock, Unlock, and Upload buttons that display the provided explanations.
Make the Vault publishing status alert (including the green “Uploaded successfully!” message with CID) more compact to reduce vertical space while keeping the status meaning and CID readable.
